summary: Retest of the MOD Ops bridge fixes and the PPM print footer from iteration_mod_ops_bridge_invoice_branding_jan2026. All previously reported issues are fixed. (1) Race: _bridge_mod_fault_to_bfpo now atomically claims the issue with find_one_and_update before inserting, and the partial unique index uniq_mod_issue_id exists. The concurrency test (12 parallel unthrottled /faults/sync + 4 throttled GETs over 10 faults) passed 5 of 5 runs, and there are 0 duplicate mod_issue_id groups in the DB. (2) Own-desk double-listing: issues with a MOD-org svc_case source_meta.issue_id are now skipped. PASS. (3) _safe_bridge is throttled to once per 30s per process with a lock. Verified: a GET after waiting 31s bridges, and an immediate second GET does not. (4) A bridged job now gets an 'intake' event ('Fault logged by X at site'), and site-resolved auto-close writes a timeline note. Both verified via the API and the /bfpo staff job detail UI. (5) PPM Print report: I rendered the exact CSS in Chromium print-to-PDF. The footer art (1800x310) sits at y 740-842 of 843pt on every page of both 1-page and 4-page reports, and content always ends above it (max y 729), so nothing overlaps. The header prints on page 1. (6) The wide-logo tests are updated and pass.

minor.issue: 163 existing bridged jobs have no svc_case_events, so their staff Activity Timeline card is still an empty white box. Backfill an intake event in backfill_mod_bridge, or add an empty state in StaffJobDetail.js.

Test-data depletion, not an app bug. The workflow test is destructive and has used up every Gibraltar case in new/assigned (left: 2 closed, 2 paused_parts, 1 on_site). Re-seed the BFPO demo data or make the test create its own case.

issues: No empty-state message in Activity Timeline for jobs with no events (affects legacy bridged jobs only).

Re-seed the BFPO Gibraltar demo cases, or make TestGuidedWorkflow create its own case, so the regression test is repeatable.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /bfpo/faults/sync calls _ensure_mod_faults_bridged directly with no throttle or lock. This is safe now that the claim is atomic, but any bfpo user can trigger a full scan as often as they like. Consider rate-limiting it or reusing _BRIDGE_LOCK.

_bridge_mod_fault_to_bfpo: if insert_one fails, bfpo_case_id is reset to None. If the failure is the unique-index DuplicateKeyError, the issue is left unlinked even though a case already exists. Look up the existing case by mod_issue_id and link it instead.
Throttle state is per process. With several uvicorn workers, each one bridges independently. This is fine because the claim is atomic.
bfpo.py is still 1443 lines. Split the bridge/staff routes into separate modules.
